sections.heading: C2 — KG hints for Advanced Driver-Assistance Systems
sections.markdown:
## C2 — KG hints for Advanced Driver-Assistance Systems

FACT_ID: sec09-R01 | anchor: A01
Test day welcomes safety helpers like backup cameras, while convenience helpers like adaptive cruise stay barred [A01].
Why it matters: group_hint test-sorting; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec09-F02.
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0026]

FACT_ID: sec09-R02 | anchor: A01
A long warning roster earns test-day approval, while only four acting assists join them [A01].
Why it matters: group_hint test-sorting; prereq_hint sec09-F02; difficulty_hint two; confusable_with sec09-F03 and sec09-F04.
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0026]

FACT_ID: sec09-R03 | anchor: A02
Warning systems stay passive announcers, while the driver stays the actor who prevents the crash [A02].
Why it matters: group_hint warn-purpose; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec09-F05.
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0027]

FACT_ID: sec09-R04 | anchor: A02
Backup warnings scan astern in reverse, while blind-spot warnings scan alongside for lane changes [A02].
Why it matters: group_hint warn-cameras; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec09-F06 and sec09-F07.
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0027]

FACT_ID: sec09-R05 | anchor: A03
Rear cameras show astern in reverse, while sideview cameras show alongside on signal [A03].
Why it matters: group_hint cameras; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec09-F08 and sec09-F09.
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0028]

FACT_ID: sec09-R06 | anchor: A03
Sideview streams one beside lane, while surround-view stitches four cameras into a parking bird's-eye [A03].
Why it matters: group_hint cameras; prereq_hint sec09-F09; difficulty_hint two; confusable_with sec09-F09 and sec09-F10.
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0028]

FACT_ID: sec09-R07 | anchor: A04
Detection flags bikes, walkers, and obstacles at low speed, while curve warnings flag hot entries by GPS [A04].
Why it matters: group_hint detection; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec09-F11 and sec09-F13.
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0029]

FACT_ID: sec09-R08 | anchor: A04
Beeps quicken as gaps shrink, while dirty sensors silence every warning [A04].
Why it matters: group_hint sensors; prereq_hint sec09-F11; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec09-F12 and sec09-F14.
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0029]

FACT_ID: sec09-R09 | anchor: A05
Crash warnings never brake for you, while their sweeps reach 500 feet twenty times a second [A05].
Why it matters: group_hint fcw; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint two; confusable_with sec09-F15 and sec09-F16.
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0030]

FACT_ID: sec09-R10 | anchor: A05
Speed alerts call for a gentle lift, while lane warnings lean on painted lines [A05].
Why it matters: group_hint speed-lane; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec09-F17 and sec09-F18.
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0030]

FACT_ID: sec09-R11 | anchor: A06
Parking sensors beep at still objects, while cross-traffic alerts warn of crossing cars [A06].
Why it matters: group_hint parking; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec09-F19.
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0031]

FACT_ID: sec09-R12 | anchor: A06
Warning systems only announce, while assist systems brake or steer with you [A06].
Why it matters: group_hint assist-purpose; prereq_hint sec09-F05; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec09-F20 and sec09-F21.
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0031]

FACT_ID: sec09-R13 | anchor: A07
Reverse braking halts the car for rear obstacles, while lane keeping nudges it home between lines [A07].
Why it matters: group_hint assists; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint two; confusable_with sec09-F22 and sec09-F23.
Source: [A07 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0032]

FACT_ID: sec09-R14 | anchor: A07
Lane keeping quits on faint paint, while left-turn avoidance freezes short gaps at slow lefts [A07].
Why it matters: group_hint assists; prereq_hint sec09-F23; difficulty_hint two; confusable_with sec09-F23 and sec09-F24.
Source: [A07 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0032]

FACT_ID: sec09-R15 | anchor: A08
Adaptive cruise holds a following gap you set, while auto parking finds a slot you brake into [A08].
Why it matters: group_hint convenience; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec09-F26 and sec09-F27.
Source: [A08 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0033]

FACT_ID: sec09-R16 | anchor: A08
Conveniences sit out test day entirely, while the owner manual stays required reading [A08].
Why it matters: group_hint convenience; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec09-F25 and sec09-F28.
Source: [A08 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0033]
